messages:
Maria (Sales): Hey team — HelioMed POC asking for an "EU data flow affidavit" attached to the Order Form. They want confirmation that data will stay in EU and an affidavit signed by us + countersigned by their legal. Any precedent?

Alex (Legal): @Maria we can do a supplemental affidavit but need to confirm hosting region and any subprocessors. Do we have them pinned to eu-west-1 dedicated or Hosted? :thinking:

Sarah (Ops): They're on Hosted but requested EU-only routing. I've confirmed customer routing to eu-west-1 and logs show no cross-region backups. We can provide an operations statement and limited subprocessor list.

Rachel (Legal): Draft template available from last year (redacted). We usually attach a short affidavit + SCCs or EU Addendum. Notarization is unusual — did they explicitly ask for notarized signature?

Maria (Sales): Yes, customer legal wrote: "we require notarized affidavit and countersignature from Redwood's authorized signatory for POC order." They want this before issuing PO.

Tom (Finance): Finance concerns: notarization and countersignature can delay payment. If they need wet-ink + notary we should ask whether a certified e-signature (DocuSign with audit trail) is acceptable. Also need PO terms: Net30 vs Net45?

Alex (Legal): Ask them if DocuSign with certified audit trail + company attestation is acceptable. If they insist on wet-ink notarization, we'll need Exec Legal approval and to route to authorized signatory — longer lead time.

Maria (Sales): I'll ping their counsel now. Quick note on PO: they indicated Net30 but attached a placeholder PO with Net15. Clarifying.

(5m later)

HelioMed Legal: Maria — Hi, DocuSign is okay only if it includes "qualified electronic signature" under eIDAS. Otherwise we need notarized wet-ink. PO will be Net30, apologies for placeholder.

Maria (Sales): FYI — they accept eIDAS QES or wet-ink. Net30 confirmed.

Rachel (Legal): QES is stricter than standard DocuSign. We can produce a signed affidavit via our e-sign provider if they support QES. Need to check vendor capability. @Sarah can you ask infra/vendor-ops who manages e-sign?

Sarah (Ops): Confirmed — our vendor supports advanced e-signatures but not all accounts have QES enabled. We need Ops to request QES from vendor (support ticket). Typical turnaround 2-3 business days.

Alex (Legal): Given timeline, propose two paths: (A) provide non-notarized affidavit + SCCs + technical ops statement and see if that's accepted; (B) if they require QES then we escalate Ops ticket and route to Exec signatory. Which do we prefer?

Maria (Sales): Customer wants affidavit before PO, but they said QES preferred. Let's offer (A) as interim and start Ops ticket for QES in parallel. Keeps pipeline moving.

Tom (Finance): Agree. Also need to adjust orderform: add one-line billing note about 30-day payment terms and invoicing sent to ar@heliomed.com. I'll prep the PO wording.

Maria (Sales): I'll send proposed interim attestation + SCCs + ops statement and flag that a QES final will follow pending vendor ticket. Also will attach provisional PO noting Net30 and invoice contact.

Alex (Legal): Please include this language in the interim affidavit: "Redwood Inference confirms that, for the HelioMed POC, customer data will be processed exclusively in eu-west-1 and limited subprocessors are listed in Appendix A. This statement does not modify the Master Services Agreement." Keep it short.

Maria (Sales): Copying draft below.

Maria (Sales): ```
Attestation: Redwood Inference confirms that, for the limited Proof-of-Concept engagement with HelioMed, all customer data will be processed in eu-west-1 (EU) and will not be transferred to non-EU regions. Subprocessors used for this engagement are listed in Appendix A. This statement is provided for the POC and does not amend the terms of the Master Services Agreement.
```

Rachel (Legal): LGTM with minor edits — remove "will not be transferred to non-EU regions" (avoid absolute phrasing) and add "subject to standard security practices". I'll provide redline in thread.

docuploader-bot: Order form draft uploaded: /files/HELIOMED_PO_0001.pdf (uploaded by Maria (Sales))

Maria (Sales): Thanks — I'll send interim packet now and start Ops ticket for QES. If they push wet-ink, we'll pause PO acceptance until Exec sign-off.

Tom (Finance): I'll standby to update billing contact and send invoice after countersign. :thumbsup:

(Resolved next day)

Maria (Sales): They accepted interim attestation + SCCs. Ops ticket for QES raised (TICKET-7891). Closing for now; will reopen if they ask for wet-ink notarization.
